zuora_account_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a customer account changes in Zuora, including its balance when it is invoiced or paid. Changes made before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The account's number, such as A00000001
output.auto_pay: True if payments are collected automatically
output.balance: What the customer owes on invoices and debit memos
output.bill_cycle_day: The day of the month the account is billed; 0 if Zuora sets it
output.bill_to_email: The bill-to contact's work email, or personal email
output.bill_to_phone: The bill-to contact's work phone, or mobile
output.created_at: When it was added to Zuora (ISO 8601)
output.crm_id: The account's ID in your CRM
output.currency: The account's currency, such as USD
output.custom_fields: Custom fields your tenant added, by their API name (ending in __c)
output.name: The account's name
output.payment_term: The payment term, such as Net 30
output.total_invoice_balance: What the customer owes on invoices

zuora_invoice_overdue_trigger.description: Runs once for each posted invoice that passes its due date with something still owed, within a week of the due date. Invoices already overdue when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The customer account's number, such as A00000001
output.balance: What is still owed on it
output.created_at: When it was added to Zuora (ISO 8601)
output.custom_fields: Custom fields your tenant added, by their API name (ending in __c)
output.days_overdue: How many days past its due date it is
output.invoice_number: The invoice's number, such as INV00000255
output.payment_amount: What has been paid on it
output.posted_date: When it was posted (ISO 8601); empty while a draft
output.target_date: The date it billed charges up to (YYYY-MM-DD)

zuora_invoice_posted_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is posted in Zuora, with its amount, balance and due date. Invoices posted before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The customer account's number, such as A00000001
output.balance: What is still owed on it
output.created_at: When it was added to Zuora (ISO 8601)
output.custom_fields: Custom fields your tenant added, by their API name (ending in __c)
output.invoice_number: The invoice's number, such as INV00000255
output.payment_amount: What has been paid on it
output.posted_date: When it was posted (ISO 8601); empty while a draft
output.target_date: The date it billed charges up to (YYYY-MM-DD)

zuora_new_account_trigger.description: Runs when a customer account is added to Zuora, with its bill-to contact. Accounts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The account's number, such as A00000001
output.auto_pay: True if payments are collected automatically
output.balance: What the customer owes on invoices and debit memos
output.bill_cycle_day: The day of the month the account is billed; 0 if Zuora sets it
output.bill_to_email: The bill-to contact's work email, or personal email
output.bill_to_phone: The bill-to contact's work phone, or mobile
output.created_at: When it was added to Zuora (ISO 8601)
output.crm_id: The account's ID in your CRM
output.currency: The account's currency, such as USD
output.custom_fields: Custom fields your tenant added, by their API name (ending in __c)
output.name: The account's name
output.payment_term: The payment term, such as Net 30
output.total_invoice_balance: What the customer owes on invoices

zuora_new_order_trigger.description: Runs when an order is placed in Zuora, such as a new subscription or a change to one. Orders placed before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The customer account's number, such as A00000001
output.created_at: When it was added to Zuora (ISO 8601)
output.order_date: The date the order was signed (YYYY-MM-DD)
output.order_number: The order's number, such as O-00000895
output.status: Completed, Pending, Draft, Scheduled, Executing, Failed or Cancelled

zuora_new_refund_trigger.description: Runs when a refund is made in Zuora, with its amount, method and what it refunds. Refunds made before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The customer account's number, such as A00000001
output.created_at: When it was added to Zuora (ISO 8601)
output.method: How it was refunded, such as CreditCard or Check
output.refund_number: The refund's number, such as R-00000001
output.source: What it refunds: Payment, CreditBalance or CreditMemo

zuora_new_subscription_trigger.description: Runs when a subscription is created in Zuora, with its account, term and rate plans. Subscriptions already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The customer account's number, such as A00000001
output.auto_renew: True if it renews by itself at the end of the term
output.cancelled_date: When the cancellation takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD); empty if not cancelled
output.created_at: When the subscription was first created (ISO 8601)
output.current_term: How long the current term is
output.custom_fields: Custom fields your tenant added, by their API name (ending in __c)
output.initial_term: How long the first term is
output.order_id: The order that made this version
output.renewal_term: How long each renewal term is
output.status: Active, Cancelled, Suspended, Pending Activation, Pending Acceptance or Draft
output.subscription_end_date: When it ends (YYYY-MM-DD); empty if it doesn't
output.subscription_number: The subscription's number, such as A-S00000001
output.version: Its version; each change adds one

zuora_payment_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a payment fails in Zuora (its status is Error), with what the payment gateway said. Payments that failed before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The customer account's number, such as A00000001
output.applied_amount: How much of it is applied to invoices
output.created_at: When it was added to Zuora (ISO 8601)
output.gateway_state: Where the payment gateway is with it, such as Submitted
output.payment_number: The payment's number, such as P-00000026
output.reference_id: The payment gateway's reference for it
output.refund_amount: How much of it was refunded
output.status: Processed, Processing, Error, Canceled, Draft or Posted
output.type: External (recorded) or Electronic (charged through a gateway)
output.unapplied_amount: How much of it is not applied yet

zuora_payment_received_trigger.description: Runs when a payment is processed in Zuora, charged or recorded, with how much of it is applied. Payments made before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.account_number: The customer account's number, such as A00000001
output.applied_amount: How much of it is applied to invoices
output.created_at: When it was added to Zuora (ISO 8601)
output.gateway_state: Where the payment gateway is with it, such as Submitted
output.payment_number: The payment's number, such as P-00000026
output.reference_id: The payment gateway's reference for it
output.refund_amount: How much of it was refunded
output.status: Processed, Processing, Error, Canceled, Draft or Posted
output.type: External (recorded) or Electronic (charged through a gateway)
output.unapplied_amount: How much of it is not applied yet
